name: Cessna 208B Grand Caravan
_note: LOW confidence. Vmo 175 KIAS and VFE 125 KIAS (full flaps; 175 to 10 deg, 150 to 20 deg) are from FAA TCDS A37CE. Stall speeds Vs1 78 and Vs0 61 KIAS from the AOPA Grand Caravan EX spec page; other sources give lower Vs0 (50, forward CG), so the band is derived from the higher value. Turbine: no Vno; Vmo is stored as vne. Circuit bands are typical practice, anchored on about 1.3 x Vs0 on final. Flap handle positions (0/10/20/30) in MSFS not checked in-sim.
